oracle_definitions.candidate_oracle_coverage: Share of utterances whose ordinary candidate list still contains the gold intent cue, the gold slot values, or both in one candidate. The gold transcript is not added.
oracle_definitions.gold_transcript_oracle: The reference sentence is scored by itself, in a separate condition. It is not a member of the B0, B1, or selective candidate lists.
oracle_definitions.achieved_performance: Frames the selective layer commits. Abstention counts as not correct in the all-input rate, and selective risk is the error among commits only.

limitation: Candidate lists are written variants, not recognizer N-best lists. RETRY rescores a supplied second list. No waveform was decoded.
